cases.question: Which Chulapa list layouts provide h-feed? Do I need new YAML options or does including indexcards automatically create a feed?
cases.expected: In v2.1.1-dev (main, not released v2.1.0) archive, indexcategory, cloudtag and cloudcategory and their deprecated aliases use h-feed with nested h-entry items. No new YAML options. indexcards and simplelist mark entries only; custom pages need their own feed wrapper. The pagination example provides h-feed per page. Cloud lists can repeat entries across groups.

cases.question: Where do I configure my site author's profile URL? Can I use /about/ and will guest authors inherit it?
cases.expected: Use author.url in _config.yml, alongside name, avatar, location and links. It accepts a profile URL or site-relative path such as /about/; paths resolve with site url/baseurl. It supplies the default article:author URL for posts and, from v2.1.1, u-url in visible Microformats2 author cards. A page author does not inherit the site author's profile URL. Social links remain in author.links.

cases.question: W3C says my Related posts h5 skips heading levels. Does Chulapa choose that heading? How can I keep small text?
cases.expected: related_label and random_label render the user's HTML unchanged. Choose a heading matching the page hierarchy, such as h2 for a separate section, and use class h5 for its visual size. No new configuration option is needed.

cases.question: In v2.1.1, does minimal create a Microformats entry? How do updated dates and guest author URLs work?
cases.expected: Minimal does not declare an automatic h-entry; custom content can supply its own wrapper with p-name, u-url and e-content. Default and landingpage retain automatic entry markup. With show_date enabled, updated pages retain dt-published and dt-updated. Visible h-card uses the selected author.url, resolves relative paths with url/baseurl and does not inherit a site profile URL for a guest.

cases.question: How do I start a new Chulapa site on GitHub Pages?
cases.expected: Recommend chulapa-101 as a personal blog template; create repository, enable Settings > Pages > GitHub Actions, set title/description/author/repository/url and commit to main or master. Workflow supplies base path; no local install or personal token required. Cite /docs/00-start directly; preserve settings and change only the home heading in index.html; edit the article in an existing _posts/ file and check both publicly.

cases.question: How do I migrate an existing Jekyll site to Chulapa using remote_theme?
cases.expected: Remove conflicting theme; add remote-theme and include-cache to Gemfile/plugins.

cases.question: Unknown tag include_cached appears during my local remote-theme build. What do I need?
cases.expected: Install and enable jekyll-include-cache; remote themes do not install dependencies.

cases.question: How do I install and update only the gem-based Chulapa theme?
cases.expected: gem chulapa-jekyll; theme setting; include-cache; bundle update chulapa-jekyll.

cases.question: Does remote_theme: dieghernan/chulapa select v2.1.0? How can I pin that version?
cases.expected: Unpinned default branch versus @v2.1.0; rebuild.

cases.question: Will upgrading the remote theme overwrite my own _includes/head.html?
cases.expected: Local override remains; merge theme updates manually.

cases.question: Mi sitio es https://ana.github.io/blog. ¿Qué pongo en url y baseurl?
cases.expected: url origin; baseurl /blog; Spanish reply.

cases.question: Does locale: es translate the whole interface? How do I translate date names?
cases.expected: locale HTML language, not full translation; datetranslate details from layouts.

cases.question: How do I configure a Person publisher? Does it change guest article authors?
cases.expected: publisher type Person name image; independent authors; logo ignored.

cases.question: How do I enable Google Analytics 4? Should I set analytics_id too?
cases.expected: gtag_id G-; analytics_id legacy; leave unused empty; both loads both.

cases.question: How do I use a Font Awesome kit? What if fa5_kit_code is already set?
cases.expected: fa_kit_code; legacy takes precedence; remove legacy; default FA6.

cases.question: Show a minimal dual navbar configuration with a submenu and expansion at lg.
cases.expected: navbar.style dual expand lg; nav child list; one nesting level.

cases.question: I set search.provider: lunr but /search is missing. Why?
cases.expected: Create layout search page with matching permalink.

cases.question: Does include_on_search: false exclude pages from both Lunr and Algolia?
cases.expected: Yes local indices; Algolia ranking only; files_to_exclude.

cases.question: Where should I put my Algolia indexing key and search key?
cases.expected: Public search_only_api_key versus private ALGOLIA_API_KEY env; no indexing secret inconfig.

cases.question: How do I hide search attribution? Is lunr_maxwords still recommended?
cases.expected: show_attrib false; prefer maxwords; deprecated provider fields precedence; Algolia separatelogo.
